description: How each workflow is doing: runs, outcomes and success ratio over the last 24 hours, the last run's result, and what is starting runs.

panels.title: Success ratio (24 h)
panels.description: Succeeded over succeeded plus failed, for runs created in the last 24 hours. Cancelled and unfinished runs are in neither count.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"succeeded"})) or vector(0)) / sum(max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"succeeded|failed"}))

panels.title: Runs (24 h)
panels.description: Runs created in the last 24 hours.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}))

panels.title: Succeeded (24 h)
panels.description: Runs created in the last 24 hours that succeeded.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"succeeded"}))

panels.title: Failed (24 h)
panels.description: Runs created in the last 24 hours that failed.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"failed"}))

panels.title: Cancelled (24 h)
panels.description: Runs created in the last 24 hours that were cancelled.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"cancelled"}))

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: Runs created in the last 24 hours that are pending or running.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"pending|running"}))

panels.title: Workflow statistics
panels.description: One row per workflow, for runs created in the last 24 hours. Mean duration and last run come from the engines selected, since they started.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}))
sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"succeeded"}))
sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"failed"}))
sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"cancelled"}))

sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"pending|running"}))

(sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"succeeded"})) or sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"succeeded|failed"})) * 0) / sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"succeeded|failed"}))

sum by (workflow) (scheduler_workflow_run_duration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}) / sum by (workflow) (scheduler_workflow_run_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"})

max by (workflow) ((scheduler_workflow_last_run_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"} and (scheduler_workflow_last_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"} == on (workflow) group_left max by (workflow) (scheduler_workflow_last_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}))))
time() - max by (workflow) (scheduler_workflow_last_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"})

panels.title: Runs finished by workflow
panels.description: Runs the selected engines finalized in each interval, by workflow.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow) (increase(scheduler_workflow_run_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Failed runs by workflow
panels.description: Runs that ended failed in each interval, by workflow.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow) (increase(scheduler_workflow_run_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status="failed"}[$__interval])) > 0

panels.title: Last run outcome
panels.description: Whether each workflow's most recently finished run succeeded. A workflow that turns red and stays red is broken, not flaky.

targets.expr: min by (workflow) ((scheduler_workflow_last_run_success{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"} and (scheduler_workflow_last_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"} == on (workflow) group_left max by (workflow) (scheduler_workflow_last_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}))))

panels.title: Runs by status (24 h window)
panels.description: Runs created in the last 24 hours, by their current status.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_recent_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}))

panels.title: Runs created per second
panels.description: Every run the selected engines created, whatever started it: the API, a schedule, a dataset trigger, a backfill or an ingest source.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(scheduler_runs_created_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Schedule decisions
panels.description: Fires a when: gate skipped, and schedules a stopStrategy expression switched off.

targets.expr: sum (increase(scheduler_schedule_gated_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval]))
sum (increase(scheduler_schedules_stopped_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Datasets
panels.description: Updates recorded (a produces: task succeeding, or an external event) and the runs those updates started through on_datasets:.

targets.expr: sum(rate(scheduler_dataset_updates_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(scheduler_dataset_fires_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Overdue schedules
panels.description: Catch-up schedules with a missed fire still outstanding.

targets.expr: max(scheduler_overdue_schedules{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Largest schedule lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest outstanding missed fire across all catch-up schedules.

targets.expr: max(scheduler_schedule_lag_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Stalled runs
panels.description: Runs still running past the stall SLA.

targets.expr: max(scheduler_incomplete_runs{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
max(scheduler_schedule_lag_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Runs made by catch-up and auto-rerun
panels.description: Runs materialized for missed fires, and failed runs re-armed from their failure frontier.

targets.expr: sum (increase(scheduler_catchup_runs_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval]))
sum (increase(scheduler_auto_reruns_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval]))

title: dagron — workflow statistics
